source_excerpt: The meta span reports what actually happened (issue #340): when the host advertises `downloadFile`, the widget sends `file:///query_results.csv` with a 600 s request timeout (overriding the SDK's 60 s default so an open save dialog does not time out) and stops there whatever the result — a resolved result shows "Downloaded query_results.csv ✓", and a result with `isError: true` (user cancelled or host refused) shows "Download cancelled or blocked by the host." with no clipboard fallback. Only a host without `downloadFile` ("This host can't save files") or a thrown request ("Download failed (<message>)", or "Download failed (timed out)" for error code `-32001`) falls through to the clipboard, whose message names that reason ("<reason> — CSV copied to clipboard"); the overlay hint reads "<reason> and the clipboard is blocked. Select all and copy:". Any CSV warning is appended to each message and keeps it on screen.
